Corollary
[constancy of the tangential component]

↗ prop:dc-ch5-3-6

1. ch5:3.7If $\langle J,\gamma '\rangle (t_1)=\langle J,\gamma '\rangle (t_2)$, $t_1,t_2\in [0,a]$, $t_1\neq t_2$, then $\langle J,\gamma '\rangle $ does not depend on $t$; in particular, if $J(0)=J(a)=0$, then $\langle J,\gamma '\rangle (t)\equiv 0$.
Proof

\sketch An affine function taking the same value at two distinct times has zero slope. If $J$ vanishes at both endpoints, that constant value is zero.

□
